MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p
WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND p.nationality IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CASE
       WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
       ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %-d, %Y')
     END AS birth_date
WITH nationality,
     DATE_PART('year', DATE('2026-10-14')) - DATE_PART('year', birth_date) -
     CASE
       WHEN DATE_PART('month', birth_date) > DATE_PART('month', DATE('2026-10-14'))
         OR (DATE_PART('month', birth_date) = DATE_PART('month', DATE('2026-10-14'))
             AND DATE_PART('day', birth_date) > DATE_PART('day', DATE('2026-10-14')))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p
WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND p.nationality IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ', ', 2) AS INT64) END AS birth_year,
     CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'January' THEN 1
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'February' THEN 2
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'March' THEN 3
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'April' THEN 4
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'May' THEN 5
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'June' THEN 6
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'July' THEN 7
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'August' THEN 8
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'September' THEN 9
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'October' THEN 10
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'November' THEN 11
          WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'December' THEN 12 END AS birth_month,
     CASE WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ', ', 1), ' ', 2), ',', '') AS INT64) END AS birth_day
WITH nationality, 2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2
